class.name: FmodPluginsSettings
class.brief_description: The FMOD plugins the game uses, such as Steam Audio or Resonance.
class.description: Saved as a resource and set in Project Settings under [code]Fmod/Plugins[/code]. FMOD loads the plugins at startup, and exports pack their libraries. Desktop and Android load dynamic libraries; iOS links static libraries registered through the methods in [member static_plugins_methods].

members.member: The names of the plugin libraries to load on desktop and Android, without platform prefix or extension.
The folder holding the plugin libraries, one subfolder per platform.
The registration methods of the plugins linked statically on iOS.
